none: PAS WMID-4F0C08: Roman Coin: Nummus of the House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Shropshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

An incomplete copper alloy Roman Nummus of the House of Constantine (AD 306 - AD 361), possibly SALVS REI PVBLICE reverse type, SAL in inscription, reverse depiction is almost completely worn away. Obverse depicts a possible radiate crowned bust right (or possibly Empress bust right with wavy hair). Dating to the period AD 324 - AD 326, (Reece Period: 16). Mint: Uncertain. Diameter: 13.5 mm. Thickness: 1.1 mm. Weight: 0.4 g. Coin is heavily corroded and most of the detail has been worn away
